issue: No validation for invalid/conflicting time frames in experience entries
actual: Setting End Date (2019-01) earlier than Start Date (2020-01) for a work experience entry was accepted without any warning or error. The Live Preview rendered the illogical range 'Jan 2020 - Jan 2019' with no validation message.

evidence: Start/End Date fields are native HTML `type=month` inputs; attempting to set an arbitrary invalid string value (e.g. 'invalid-date') via the DOM was rejected by the browser and the field remained empty, enforcing correct YYYY-MM format entry.
Clicking 'New Resume' created a new 'Untitled Resume' with an empty editor (Contact, Summary, Experience, Education, Skills tabs all blank), ready for data entry.
Template tab offers 3 preset styles (Modern, Classic, Minimal). Selecting 'Classic' visibly changed the Live Preview rendering style (contact separators, date format) instantly.
Entered Full Name, Email, Phone, Location, Summary, one Work Experience (company/title/dates), one Education entry, and one Skill; all fields accepted input and persisted in the form.

Sections tab allows renaming section headings via editable textboxes and reordering sections via up/down buttons. Renamed 'Work Experience' to 'Career History' and moved it above 'Professional Summary'; both changes applied.
A 'Live Preview' panel is shown alongside the editor at all times, rendering the resume as data is entered.

Each edit (contact fields, summary text, experience, education, skill, template switch) was reflected in the Live Preview immediately in the same snapshot after the action, with no stale or missing data observed.
Renaming 'Work Experience' to 'Career History' and moving it above 'Professional Summary' both took effect instantly in the Live Preview without needing any extra confirmation step.

Card menu offers Rename/Duplicate/Delete. Duplicate created 'QA Test Resume - Backend Role (Copy)' with identical content; Rename dialog changed its title to 'QA Test Resume - Sales Role' successfully via Save button.

Multiple resume versions (QA Test Resume - Backend Role, QA Test Resume - Sales Role, plus 3 pre-existing sample resumes) coexist in the 'Your Resumes' list, each independently accessible and editable.

Searching 'Marketing' in the search box correctly filtered the list to only 'Marketing Manager Resume'. Sort dropdown offers Newest First/Oldest First/Title A-Z/Title Z-A; selecting 'Title A-Z' correctly re-ordered all 5 resumes alphabetically.

Changed Full Name to 'Sales Person Name' in the duplicated 'Sales Role' resume; re-opening the original 'Backend Role' resume still showed Full Name 'Jane Smith', confirming independent storage with no content sharing between versions.
Resume title 'QA Test Resume - Backend Role' shown identically in the editor header and in the 'Your Resumes' list card heading after navigating back to the home page.

issue: No user feedback/confirmation shown after auto-saving resume edits
actual: The app auto-persists edits (data reappears correctly after navigating back to the resume), but no explicit 'Save' action or confirmation feedback (toast, banner, checkmark, 'Saved' text) is shown after edits. The Notifications region/toast list remained empty after multiple field edits and navigation events.

issue: Newly created/edited resumes are not persisted across a page reload
actual: Created two resumes ('QA Test Resume - Backend Role' and its duplicate/rename 'QA Test Resume - Sales Role') with full content (contact, summary, experience, education, skills, LinkedIn/Website). After performing an actual page reload (navigating to http://localhost:7005/), both resumes disappeared entirely from 'Your Resumes' — only the original 3 seeded sample resumes (Product Designer, Marketing Manager, Software Engineer) remained. This shows data is kept only in-memory/session state and is lost on reload, violating the persistence requirement.

evidence: Inspected 'Minimal' template preview (Product Designer Resume): full contact block with LinkedIn/Website, summary paragraph, Experience section with two full entries (title, company, dates, description), Skills chips, and Education with GPA all rendered completely with no missing or truncated sections. Modern and Classic templates likewise rendered every section fully during earlier testing.

All entered fields (Full Name, Email, Phone, Location, LinkedIn, Website, Summary, Experience company/title/dates/description, Education institution/degree/field/dates, Skills) were fully retained and correctly displayed both in the form and Live Preview when navigating away and back to the resume within the session (verified on both the self-created resume and the seeded 'Product Designer Resume' with a full field set including optional LinkedIn/Website/GPA).
